dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Program ORCGJ02 is the accounting card input component (J02).
evidence: no EXEC CICS or EXEC SQL

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (rezept) processing system - accounting card data entry component for the JMA ORCA standard receipt software
purpose.summary: ORCGJ02 is the accounting card input program (J02) of the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It handles patient insurance information entry, medical treatment accounting, hospitalization records, and receipt review processing. The program manages complex Japanese medical insurance billing workflows including multiple insurance combinations, treatment history, and receipt electronic data migration.

notable_features: 90 COPY statements indicating heavy use of copybooks
97 CALL statements for modular subprogram architecture
1033 PERFORM statements indicating structured procedural logic
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
Japanese EUC or Shift-JIS encoded comments (latin-1 decoded with mojibake)
REDEFINES clauses used for display formatting
verdict.notes: Comments are encoded in Japanese (likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS) but decoded as latin-1, resulting in mojibake in the visible text. The program is clearly part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system used widely in Japanese medical clinics. No COMP-3 is unusual for a financial/accounting program but consistent with ORCA's coding style. Source truncated at 16000 chars; full file is ~673KB with 15786 lines.
